wiki.title: Angelina Cruz
wiki.extract: Angelina M. Cruz (born c.1979) is an American public school teacher, union leader, and Democratic politician from Racine, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 62nd Assembly district since 2025. She is the first Latina to represent Racine County in the Wisconsin Legislature. She is also president of Racine Educators United, Racine's teachers' union, since 2016.
